and expected outcomes. Since 2010, the Intel Founda-

Global Intel Involved Hero
Lin Huan Ang has a strong passion for helping children. She dedicates most of her free 
time to helping teachers develop plans to implement early literacy intervention pro-
grams at the BOLD Association for Children with Special Needs in Penang, Malaysia. 
Ang also volunteers at a rural school, where she has engaged volunteer teams to build 
an impressive sustainable garden and organized workshops on gardening, composting, 
enzyme making, and food safety. In addition, she has organized skills-based workshops, 
and donations of surplus laptops, used furniture, and IT maintenance activities in the 
computer labs. 
In 2016, Ang was the winner of the Global Intel Involved Hero Award, which shines a 
spotlight on extraordinary employee volunteers who have made a significant and lasting

impact by working with nonprofit organizations or schools to address community needs 
or enhance the organization’s capacity to meet its mission. Finalists for the honor each
